scope: Read-only structural comparison of a separate candidate field-trial plan with declared schema-3 food-chain observations and service rows
protocol_requirements_checked_structural: plan and observation study ID, exact group IDs, arms, strata and pre/post windows match
at least 12 groups, six or more in each arm, balanced total arms and both arms in every declared stratum
pre and post declared windows span at least four and eight weeks respectively
declared plan registration predates assignment and its evidence source
a registration after baseline observation begins requires a declared baseline first-access record dated after registration
the underlying schema-3 field graph and service rows pass audit_field_flows
negative_controls: the prior two-group synthetic field-flow fixture passes its graph preflight but is rejected as an inadequate trial design
plan/observation arm, group or window mismatch is rejected
missing service rows, short post window and a stratum with only one arm are rejected
duplicate JSON keys are rejected by the CLI without a success report
a late declared registration without a baseline release, an access time at or before registration, and an assignment source earlier than registration are rejected
positive_control: A generated 12-group synthetic schema-3 graph with six per arm and a matching candidate plan passes structural checks while criterion_3 remains not_assessed.

independent_review.reviewer: native read-only adversarial development agent, not a field custodian
independent_review.initial_finding: The first version accepted a registration date after the baseline window began, which could allow criteria to be chosen after baseline results were seen if those results were accessible.
independent_review.qualification: Observation date alone does not prove access; sealed baseline data could remain unopened until after registration.
independent_review.follow_up_verdict: Chronology issue closed within the declarative contract; no further reproduced false green in the reviewed scope.
independent_review.reproductions: late registration without release rejected; release at registration rejected; later declared release accepted with authentication false; assignment source before registration rejected

checks.command: uv run --no-sync ruff check scripts/audit_field_trial_design.py tests/test_audit_field_trial_design.py; python3 -m compileall -q scripts/audit_field_trial_design.py; git diff --check

cli_behavior: Reads and hashes the exact input bytes, reports a structural match, and leaves the supplied files unchanged; failure exits 2 without a success JSON report.
limitations: The candidate plan, dates, allocation source and baseline release record can be fabricated together; no independent custody or timestamp authority is checked.
An allocation_record_sha256 or baseline_release.record_sha256 is syntactically checked but its referenced bytes are not inspected or authenticated.
Window length does not prove weekly measurement coverage, randomization, group independence, statistical power or prevention of contamination.
The service equivalence and field observations remain declarations; the script does not calculate V, G, a causal interval, harms or costs.
All test lots, sources, dates, approvals and outcomes are synthetic. No food-chain intervention or field impact was observed.
